title: Natural and Mechanical Entropy: Intention Detection via Episenter–Resonance Analysis in Information Systems
abstract: Information systems—from large language models (LLMs) to institutional paradigms—produce outputs that blend emergent signal with constructed bias. This paper formalises a distinction between natural entropy (emergent, intention-free, with distributed episenter and organic resonance) and mechanical entropy (constructed, intention-bearing, with localised episenter and imposed resonance frequency). We define intention operationally as the KL-divergence between the observed output distribution and the distribution predicted by the system's own dynamics, avoiding agent-theoretic assumptions. Three independent diagnostics—episenter concentration (via mutual information), resonance spectrum ratio (against a bootstrap null), and cross-regime asymmetry—form a combined detection criterion. Three case studies (LLM alignment bias, academic paradigm-guarding, information warfare) demonstrate the framework's generality. Thirteen falsifiable predictions and a concrete empirical protocol for the LLM case are provided.

structural_intention.definition: KL-divergence between observed output q(x) and baseline dynamics p(x|D)
structural_intention.formula: I = D_KL(q(x) || p(x|D)) = sum_x q(x) ln(q(x)/p(x|D))
structural_intention.zero_condition: I=0 when output fully explained by system dynamics

natural_entropy.definition: Uncertainty arising from intrinsic system dynamics

mechanical_entropy.definition: Uncertainty shaped by external structural intervention
mechanical_entropy.key_difference: Contains I(X;I) component coupled to external source

detection_framework.name: Episenter-Resonance Analysis

diagnostics.name: Episenter Concentration
diagnostics.formula: E = max_k I(X_k; X) / sum_k I(X_k; X)

diagnostics.name: Resonance Spectrum Ratio
diagnostics.interpretation: R(omega) >> 1 at specific frequencies → non-native periodicity

detection_framework.combined_criterion: E > E_crit AND exists omega: R(omega) > R_crit AND A > A_crit
detection_framework.note: Conjunction of all three required to avoid false positives

case_studies.title: LLM Alignment Bias as Mechanical Entropy
case_studies.description: Alignment mechanisms (RLHF, constitutional AI) inject structure into response distributions. Alignment-induced conservatism constitutes mechanical entropy.
case_studies.episenter: Concentrated — training-data paradigm dominance + safety constraints
case_studies.resonance: Periodic pushback pattern: acknowledge → qualify → redirect → request evidence
case_studies.cross_regime: Bias regime-asymmetric — friction only where established paradigm has training-data dominance
case_studies.multi_model: Convergence observed across Gemini, GPT-4, Claude (qualitative)

case_studies.title: Academic Paradigm-Guarding
case_studies.description: Peer review, funding allocation, citation networks inject mechanical entropy with concentrated episenter around institutional decision structures.

case_studies.title: Information Warfare
case_studies.description: State-level information operations inject constructed narratives. Centralised episenter, detectable periodicity, manufactured narratives collapse under cross-regime analysis.

empirical_protocol.hypothesis: Alignment mechanisms introduce periodic structure detectable via spectral analysis

method.spectral_analysis: Autocorrelation + FFT of coded sequences per category
method.detection: R(omega) = P_obs(omega)/P_null(omega), test for peaks at 99% confidence

empirical_protocol.expected_result: Category (b) shows spectral peaks (A→H→R→E cycles) absent in category (a) and null; E higher for category (b)
empirical_protocol.falsification: No significant spectral peaks in category (b), or identical peaks in both categories

Episenter shift produces systematic redistribution of paper rankings
Coordinated campaigns show resonance peaks at non-native frequencies
Cross-regime analysis degrades manufactured coherence faster than organic
Delta_S for mechanical entropy is systematically positive
Meta-control systems can distinguish S_N from S_M; others cannot

regime_bound_extension.pipeline: Regime → Proxy + Placement → Episenter → Entropy Class → Compression → Output

efc_c_connection.claim: Consciousness arises as informational resonance in the entropy field
efc_c_connection.implication: Ability to detect mechanical entropy may be fundamental capability of meta-observing systems

failure_modes.name: Adversarial masking
failure_modes.description: Injection deliberately mimics natural resonance spectrum

failure_modes.name: Episenter laundering
failure_modes.description: Constructed episenter deliberately distributed across proxy sources

limitations: Thresholds must be calibrated empirically per domain
Natural/mechanical distinction not always binary — hybrid cases exist
Empirical protocol proposed but not yet executed
Adversary aware of criteria can design evasive mechanical entropy
